findings.title: _run_one_feature Budget Guard Uses Separate DB Session — Race Condition
findings.failure_sequence: Thread A opens get_db() for feature lookup -> Thread B records cost and pauses workflows -> Thread A opens SECOND get_db() for budget check -> Thread B's commit may not be visible -> Budget guard reads stale cost -> New workflow launches despite over-budget
findings.impact: Under concurrent feature pipelines, new features can launch after budget is exceeded
findings.fix: Reuse existing db session from earlier context block, or pass session as parameter to check_budget_before_new_work

findings.title: _pause_project_workflows Missing 'starting' Agent Status
findings.failure_sequence: Agent in 'starting' state -> Budget exceeded -> _pause_project_workflows filters ['working', 'idle'] -> Agent transitions to 'working' -> Continues spending past budget
findings.impact: Agents in 'starting' state can continue spending past budget limit
